population: Unchanged Phase 1C Boston included rows, both noon timing rules; selected external fixtures never cohort
endpoint: New documented injury-attributed absence run beginning in (decision, decision+14 elapsed days] and subsequently reaching >=10 consecutive applicable-team missed games
anchor: First injury-attributed missed game, timestamp interval; whole documented local day if actual start cannot be verified
severity: Positive requires >=10 consecutive injury-attributed games and independently reviewed common-episode continuity. Appearance ends run, never proves recovery. Mixed reasons and gaps unknown unless conservative complete-run upper bound <10.
clinical: Preserve original clinical-onset and >28-day public-span endpoints separately; no onset lower bound from appearances
transfers: Follow actual destination schedules from transaction date; missing roster, reason or followup remains unknown; former-team games never counted
negative: Conditional on Phase1C bounded B surveillance and adequate applicable-team followup, all potentially in-window runs resolved
publication: A verified historical availability unchanged; B original registered lags and source coverage; C outcome-only evidence. Never manufacture label_known_at
fixtures: Randle Jan27 2024 and Ball Nov26 2023: actual prior games, both timing rules, same B eligibility coverage required. Unknown if coverage insufficient. Selected cases are integration fixtures only.
boundaries: Only 2023-24 development sources; no models, protected holdouts or population expansion
